correctness.rationale: DLMF 18.17.21 plus precisely normalized sine-Plancherel proves every exact moment. Binomial expansion gives rational coefficients. The matched Hilb interior Bessel core and oscillatory Legendre tail yield (log K+gamma+log 32)/(2 pi^2 K)+o(1/K); the Bessel-square integration constant is evaluated independently via a Laplace transform and fixed-order oscillatory asymptotics. Direct exact and numerical checks run from the standalone checker. Xu Theorem 1.3, not a new unproved lemma, supplies the separate general sharp-stability result; plugging in I0 and I1 gives the advertised evaluated constant.

originality.rationale: Under explicit caveats, Xu and Carneiro--Oliveira e Silva--Sousa do not display the exact two-term high-harmonic logarithmic decay with the Euler-constant correction. The classical Legendre--Bessel identity itself is not new and has been fully disclosed. No located database result or stronger theorem directly covered the whole claimed two-term constant. There remains real historical-priority uncertainty for general weighted Legendre norm asymptotics.

value.rationale: The modal tail governs frequency-dependent damping in a natural mixed-norm spherical Fourier extension problem. The result supplies the complete exact rational fourth-moment spectrum in physical dimension three, a nontrivial two-term large-degree law (sharp logarithmic coefficient and explicit additive constant), and an exact evaluated optimal stability coefficient in the basic admissible even-exponent case. These are motivated analytic invariants rather than an arbitrary finite table or a repetition of modal ordering.
